title: dryopteris pseudomontana
intro: Dryopteris pseudomontana, commonly known as Western Wood Fern, is a species of fern native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Wood Fern are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant's bioactive compounds may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
